decks.notes: The key concept of this deck is to establish a fast and aggressive board presence using low-cost white creatures. The deck aims to overpower opponents by deploying a swarm of small, efficient creatures such as Thalia, Guardian of Thraben, Thalia's Lieutenant, and Adeline, Resplendent Cathar. The inclusion of cards like Brave the Elements and Eiganjo, Seat of the Empire helps protect the creatures from removal spells and combat damage. Overall, the goal is to overwhelm opponents with a relentless assault while leveraging the synergies between the creatures to generate advantage.

The deck focuses on utilizing various cards to quickly assemble and protect the Greasefang Parhelion combo. It includes cards like Grisly Salvage, Vessel of Nascency, and Traverse the Ulvenwald to find key pieces. Thoughtseize and Witherbloom Command are included to disrupt the opponent's strategy. Parhelion II and Greasefang, Okiba Boss are essential combo pieces that, when combined, can create a powerful board state. The deck also includes cards like Esika's Chariot and Scrapwork Mutt for additional value and protection. Overall, the deck aims to quickly assemble the combo while disrupting the opponent's game plan.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game through counterspells, board wipes, and card advantage. It aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy by countering important spells, wiping the board when necessary, and generating card advantage through cards like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and Memory Deluge. The deck also utilizes lands like Castle Ardenvale and Castle Vantress to generate additional value. Ultimately, the goal is to outlast the opponent and win through incremental advantage and control of the game.

The main concept of this deck is to ramp up quickly with mana-producing creatures like Elvish Mystic and Llanowar Elves, as well as Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx, to play powerful green devotion spells. The deck also focuses on generating card advantage and mana with cards like Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner and Oath of Nissa. Additionally, it includes powerful threats like Cavalier of Thorns, Nicol Bolas, Dragon-God, and Old-Growth Troll. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a combination of speed and powerful creatures while maintaining devotion to green mana.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly establish a board presence with low-cost Spirit creatures while using tempo plays to control the pace of the game. Utilizing cards like Rattlechains and Shacklegeist, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while maintaining pressure with cards like Curious Obsession and Supreme Phantom. The inclusion of counterspells like Spell Pierce and Lofty Denial helps protect the board and spells, while cards like Faceless Haven provide a late-game threat. Overall, the deck focuses on aggressive tactics with a mix of evasive creatures and disruption.

This Rakdos Sacrifice deck focuses on aggressive gameplay by utilizing sacrifice synergies and removal spells. The key strategy revolves around sacrificing creatures, such as Cauldron Familiar and Unlucky Witness, to trigger powerful effects like Mayhem Devil's damage ability. The deck also includes disruption tools like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push to disrupt opponents' game plans. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion further enhances the deck's consistency and mana acceleration. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a combination of sacrifice effects, removal, and aggressive creatures.

This deck focuses on assembling the Greasefang Parhelion combo to create a powerful board presence and overwhelm the opponent. It utilizes cards like Grisly Salvage, Vessel of Nascency, and Traverse the Ulvenwald to find key pieces quickly. Liliana of the Veil helps disrupt the opponent's hand while Parhelion II and Greasefang, Okiba Boss provide strong win conditions. Skysovereign, Consul Flagship and Esika's Chariot offer additional threats and removal options. The deck aims to quickly set up its combo pieces and control the game until it can secure a victory.

The key concept of this deck is to quickly ramp up green mana using mana dorks and Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx, to power out powerful green creatures and planeswalkers. The deck focuses on generating as much green devotion as possible to fuel Nykthos and enable powerful plays like casting multiple spells in a turn or activating powerful abilities. The deck also includes tools like Storm the Festival and Karn, the Great Creator to help find key cards and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The overall strategy is to overwhelm the opponent with efficient threats and powerful synergies.

This Rakdos Sacrifice deck focuses on utilizing sacrifice effects and synergies to control the board and deal damage to the opponent. The deck includes cards like Witch's Oven, Mayhem Devil, and Cauldron Familiar to create loops of sacrificing creatures for value. Additionally, cards like Claim the Firstborn and Fatal Push help to disrupt the opponent's game plan while Thoughtseize provides hand disruption. The deck aims to incrementally chip away at the opponent's life total while generating advantage through sacrifice interactions.

This deck focuses on creating a powerful combo with Greasefang, Okiba Boss and Parhelion II to generate advantage and overwhelm the opponent. By utilizing cards like Grisly Salvage, Thoughtseize, and Vessel of Nascency, the deck aims to set up its combo pieces quickly and efficiently. The inclusion of cards like Skysovereign, Consul Flagship and Esika's Chariot provides additional threats and ways to control the board. With a mix of ramp, removal, and card advantage, this deck aims to outpace and outvalue its opponent to achieve victory.

This deck focuses on aggressive plays using red and black cards to quickly deal damage to the opponent. Key cards include Bonecrusher Giant, Bloodtithe Harvester, and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to apply pressure on the opponent. Thoughtseize and Duress are included for disruption, while Fatal Push and Power Word Kill help to deal with opposing threats. The mana base is built around Blood Crypt and various utility lands like Mutavault and Hive of the Eye Tyrant. Overall, the deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent with its aggressive creatures and removal spells.

The main concept of this deck is to ramp up mana quickly with green devotion cards like Llanowar Elves and Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx, allowing for powerful plays early on. The deck focuses on aggressive plays with big creatures like Cavalier of Thorns and Old-Growth Troll, supported by cards like Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner and Storm the Festival. The deck also includes utility cards like Karn, the Great Creator and Boseiju, Who Endures to deal with specific threats. Overall, the strategy revolves around overwhelming the opponent with a fast and powerful green aggro deck.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on quickly playing powerful creatures and spells to pressure the opponent and disrupt their game plan. With a mix of strong early game removal, hand disruption, and aggressive creatures like Bonecrusher Giant and Kroxa, the Titan of Death's Hunger, the deck aims to chip away at the opponent's life total while controlling the board. Utilizing the powerful synergy between cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse, the deck can quickly overwhelm and out-value opponents in the mid to late game.

The main focus of this Izzet Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan through counter spells and removal while maintaining card advantage with cards like Dig Through Time and Chandra, Hope's Beacon. The deck also aims to control the board with Anger of the Gods and Spikefield Hazard while also applying pressure with Alrund's Epiphany and Temporal Trespass. The mana base is designed to provide consistent access to both colors of mana needed for control spells and removal. Overall, this deck aims to outlast and outmaneuver opponents in a longer game.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on a combination of aggressive creatures and removal spells to control the board and pressure the opponent. It leverages efficient removal like Fatal Push and Bonecrusher Giant to clear the way for creatures like Bloodtithe Harvester and Graveyard Trespasser to deal damage quickly. The inclusion of hand disruption like Thoughtseize and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger adds another layer of disruption to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Overall, the deck aims to apply early pressure and maintain control of the board to secure a quick victory.

This Rakdos Aggro Pioneer deck focuses on filling the graveyard with powerful creatures and disrupting the opponent's hand with discard spells like Thoughtseize and Duress. The deck utilizes aggressive creatures like Bonecrusher Giant and Bloodtithe Harvester to apply pressure on the opponent while using removal spells like Fatal Push and Power Word Kill to control the board. Liliana of the Veil and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse provide additional value by recurring creatures from the graveyard. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a mix of creature aggression, disruption, and graveyard manipulation.
